title: ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the results of Round Two of the 2025 WorkSource Center (WSC) Operators Request for Proposals for…
text:
[Council File 26-0327]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the results of Round Two of the 2025 WorkSource Center (WSC) Operators Request for Proposals for Program Year 2026-27; and extension of WSC Operator contracts; and updating the Replacement Operator list for the Boyle Heights and South Los Angeles Community Plan Areas (CPA).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. REPLACE the Boyle Heights WorkSource Center (WSC) Operator, Managed Career Solutions, with the Asian American Drug Abuse Program (AADAP) as in Table 3 of the Joint Community Investment Department (CID) and Workforce Development Board (WDB) report dated November 13, 2026, attached to the Council file.
2. AUTHORIZE the CID to enter into a new agreement with AADAP to operate the Boyle Heights WSC effective January 1, 2027, through the end of the current procurement cycle.
3. APPROVE the results of the 2025 WorkSource Center (WSC) Operators – Round 2 Request for Proposals (RFP), as detailed in Table 1 of the Joint CID and WDB report dated November 13, 2026, attached to the Council file.
4. AUTHORIZE the General Manager of the CID to extend and fund three (3) WSC Operator contracts through June 30, 2027, as detailed in Table 3 of the Joint CID and WDB report dated November 13, 2026, attached to the Council file.
5. AUTHORIZE the General Manager of the CID to update the Replacement Operator list for the Boyle Heights and South Los Angeles Community Plan Areas (CPA), consisting of all proposals achieving a score of 70 or higher, to remain in place for the duration of the procurement cycle, as detailed in Attachment 1 - 2025 WSC Replacement Operators List of the Joint CID and WDB report dated November 13, 2026, attached to the Council file.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The CID and WBD report that there is no fiscal impact to the City General Fund.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council replaces the Boyle Heights WorkSource Center operator with the Asian American Drug Abuse Program, approves second-round operator results, extends three operator contracts through June 2027, and updates the replacement operator list for Boyle Heights and South Los Angeles.
